newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson behind in TSA capacity plan.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson behind in TSA capacity plan.

text.p: Hutchinson Technology Inc said Monday it continues to expand its capacity to manufacture TSA suspensions at its Hutchinson, Minn., plant but is behind its capacity plan.
TSA suspensions are suspension assemblies incorporating integrated electrical leads.

"While we are currently behind our TSA suspension capacity plan, we are implementing solutions to various start-up problems and still expect to be able to produce more than two million TSA suspensions per week by the fall of 1997," the company said.
Hutchinson said five major disk drive manufacturers plan to use the company's TSA suspensions on a total of 12 disk drive programs.
Hutchinson today reported higher second quarter results.
